scripts.check: biome check scripts/*.mjs && uv run --project backend ruff check backend && uv run --project backend ruff format --check backend
scripts.fix: biome check --write scripts/*.mjs && uv run --project backend ruff check --fix backend && uv run --project backend ruff format backend
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && npm run test:deploy && uv run --project backend pytest backend/app/tests backend/tests
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test
